title: Certificates & Awards
slide_intent: Teach designers to select the seal or logotype according to the significance of an award. The form of recognition sets an expectation for ceremony and permanence.
strategic_value: NASA can distinguish sustained service from shorter-term merit through both the identifying emblem and the arrangement of the certificate.
demonstration: A traditional certificate centers the seal over the recipient’s name and signatures. Two smaller merit certificates use red logotypes with more contemporary type arrangements.
practical_value: Match the identity treatment to the award type. The manual specifies the seal for a length-of-federal-service certificate and its accompanying service pin.
